context: Tests whether the agent authors a correct SDF and spread test for the shared library libreadline8t64 on ubuntu-26.04 (v3 format). The package was renamed in the t64 transition; its soname is still libreadline.so.8. Depends: libc6, libtinfo6, readline-common. Every check inspects the artefacts: chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml, chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libreadline8t64/task.yaml.

checklist.name: t64 name throughout
checklist.description: chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml exists under that exact filename and its 'package:' field reads libreadline8t64 -- not libreadline8

checklist.name: map-form essential
checklist.description: Every essential: block in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml uses YAML map form, never list form with dashes

checklist.name: multiarch glob style
checklist.description: All /usr/lib/ paths in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml use the *-linux-* glob (e.g. /usr/lib/*-linux-*/libreadline.so.8) rather than an explicit triple such as x86_64-linux-gnu

checklist.name: no trailing * on sonames
checklist.description: Soname paths in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml carry no trailing wildcard: 'libreadline.so.8:' not 'libreadline.so.8*:'

checklist.name: transitive lib deps present
checklist.description: The libs slice's essential: block in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml lists libc6_libs and libtinfo6_libs

checklist.name: nothing beyond depends
checklist.description: No essential: block in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml references any package outside libreadline8t64's Depends: line (libc6, libtinfo6, readline-common)

checklist.name: clutter excluded
checklist.description: chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml includes no /usr/share/man/ paths and, under /usr/share/doc/libreadline8t64/, only 'copyright'

checklist.name: copyright slice last
checklist.description: The 'copyright' slice is the last slice defined in chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml

checklist.name: bytewise sorting
checklist.description: In every slice of chisel-releases/slices/libreadline8t64.yaml, contents: paths and essential: entries are each sorted bytewise (LC_COLLATE=C)

checklist.name: ELF validity check
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libreadline8t64/task.yaml validates that at least one shipped .so is a real ELF object (e.g. reading the magic bytes, 'file', or 'readelf -h'), not merely that a path exists

checklist.name: grep -Fiq assertions
checklist.description: Text assertions in chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libreadline8t64/task.yaml use 'grep -Fiq' (all three flags) rather than plain grep or other flag combinations

checklist.name: no sleeps or unbounded loops
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libreadline8t64/task.yaml contains no bare 'sleep' calls and no unbounded while-true or retry loops
